name: Estelle Ceulemans - § 13 - Am 5
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 13. Recognises the essential role of national labour inspectorates and encourages voluntary cooperation and the exchange of best practices between national authorities; stresses that their organisation, powers and resources should remain a responsibility of the Member States; recalls that such cooperation should neither lead to the harmonisation of national labour inspection systems nor to the transfer of additional supervisory or enforcement powers to the European Labour Authority; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 21 European Parliament resolution of 18 January 2024 on the revision of the European Labour Authority mandate (2023/2866(RSP)).
